notes: Fair Workweek Ordinance (Emeryville Mun. Code Title 5 ch. 39), effective July 1, 2017, covers retail firms with 56+ employees globally.
Employers must first offer extra hours to existing qualified part-timers up to 35 h/week.
Right to rest: 1.5x for hours worked between shifts separated by less than 11 hours; employee may decline.

Predictability pay as read from the city's official employee notice on 2026-11-06: 1 h for changes with <14 days but >=24 h notice; with <24 h notice, 4 h or the scheduled shift length (whichever is less) for cancelled/reduced shifts, other changes 1 h. Encoded with reduced_hours_measure='scheduled_shift' (cap applies to the shift's scheduled hours, not the hours cut). The notice and ordinance could not be re-fetched on 2026-11-07 (Akamai 403), so the rule is confidence=medium and exemptions are not encoded (conservative: charge).
applies_to='both' kept from the 2026-11-06 reading (retail and fast food); not re-verified (site blocked).
min_rest_between_shifts: same-day split exclusion not verified; excludes_same_day_split not set.

params.exemption_note: Exemptions not verified: the city site blocked automated access on 2026-11-07, so no exemption is encoded and every employer change inside 14 days is charged.

rules.summary: Emeryville retail (56+ employees globally): inside 14 days, 1 hour at the regular rate per change with 24 h+ notice and for other changes with less; a cut or cancelled shift with <24 h notice pays 4 hours or the scheduled shift length, whichever is less.
